bio: Located in a residential area, this well-known seafood restaurant has over 30 years of history to its name. They serve live seafood only, from fish to shellfish – make your selection from the tank. Don't miss the famous local choices of chilli crab and black pepper crab, which boast firm and briny sweet flesh; the local cze char dishes are also good. You can sit inside or outside – the latter area is particularly atmospheric and relaxing....
